name: POST /api/media/:blob_id/transcode - Enqueue transcode job
description: Enqueues a transcode job for an existing blob (FR-MED-3) and returns 201 with the job record, whose status is then polled via GET /api/media/transcode-jobs/:job_id. pipeline is the only body field and must be one of video-mp4-hls | image-optimize | pdf-thumbnail. The blob's tenant is asserted against the JWT tenant_id claim. Edge cases: a missing or unrecognised pipeline is a 400 with the valid values echoed back; an unknown blob_id is a 404; a blob owned by another tenant is a 403; a shredded blob is a 410 Gone and cannot be transcoded; there is no duplicate-job guard, so requesting the same pipeline twice enqueues a second independent job rather than returning the first; a JWT with no tenant_id claim is a 403 rather than a 401.

errorCases.when: Authorization header absent or not in Bearer form (requireAuth / gateway default-deny authGate)
Bearer token fails JWT verification or is expired (requireAuth / gateway default-deny authGate)
The token verifies but carries no tenant_id claim
Request body is absent or not a JSON object

errorCases.message: pipeline must be one of video-mp4-hls, image-optimize, pdf-thumbnail
errorCases.when: pipeline is missing or outside the closed set

errorCases.message: requestTranscode: caller tenant <tid> does not own blob <blob_id>
errorCases.when: The blob's tenant_id differs from the JWT tenant_id claim
No blob row exists for the supplied blob_id

errorCases.message: Blob <blob_id> has been shredded; cannot transcode
errorCases.when: The blob key material was shredded, so the source object is unrecoverable
Any other requestTranscode failure (queue or database error)
